prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific firms to call — but to make the best recommendations I need a little more info. Two quick questions:
- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston are you in?
- Any special facts about the wreck (commercial truck involved, catastrophic injury, uninsured motorist, hit-and-run, passenger/pedestrian, etc.)?

While you reply, here are five reputable Houston-area personal injury firms you can call now and why each is worth contacting. They cover a range of sizes and strengths so you can compare options.

1) The Buzbee Law Firm
- Why call: Houston-based trial firm with experience handling high-value and catastrophic injury auto cases. Known for aggressive litigation and big settlements/verdicts. Good if you expect a contentious claim or need a firm that will litigate.

2) Morgan & Morgan (Houston office)
- Why call: One of the largest plaintiff personal-injury firms in the country with lots of resources (medical experts, investigators) and familiarity handling car crashes, uninsured motorist claims, and soft-tissue to catastrophic injuries. They handle large volume and offer 24/7 intake and contingency-fee representation.

3) Arnold & Itkin LLP
- Why call: Prominent Houston plaintiff trial firm experienced in catastrophic cases and complex litigation. Strong trial record and resources for serious injury or wrongful death claims (including commercial vehicle/crash or complicated liability issues).

4) The Cochran Firm (Houston)
- Why call: Nationally known plaintiff firm with local Houston presence. Experienced in auto collisions and civil litigation; can be a good option if you want a firm with national reach and local courtroom experience.

5) Local boutique/trial firms (how to find one)
- Why call: For many wrecks a smaller Houston boutique firm or a board-certified trial lawyer will deliver personalized service and local courtroom knowledge. Use the Harris County Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service or the Texas Board of Legal Specialization (search for board-certified personal injury trial lawyers) to find local, vetted options.

What to ask when you call (so you can compare firms)
- Do you handle auto wreck cases in Houston and is it a contingency fee (no upfront attorney fees)?
- How many car crash cases like mine have you handled and what were typical outcomes?
- Will a board‑certified trial lawyer handle my case or will it be passed to a junior attorney?
- Do you have experience with (insert specifics: truck/crane/UBI/commercial, brain/spinal injury, uninsured motorist, wrongful death)?
- How do you handle medical liens and treatment prior to filing suit?
- Timeline estimate and whether you expect to file suit quickly or negotiate first.

If you give your ZIP and a couple details about the crash, I’ll pull up 3–5 nearby firms tailored to your situation (and I can include phone numbers and what to say when you call).
